review: No subprocess/trace API/config mutation in tool. Reads fixed proc/tracefs paths only; writes only requested create-new output.
Every returned assessment status remains not_established and causal_worker_gc_scheduler_readiness stays false even when passive formats are readable.
Windows not-applicable and denied/missing/unavailable/unknown/empty formats prevent passive_format_inventory_complete.
Passive format completeness is separate from active capture permission, event delivery, loss and clock/identity joins.
observe distinguishes missing/denied/other OSError without converting failure into event absence.
limitations: Self-tests are assert-based and must be run without Python -O.
Inventory is not active capture permission proof; no actual target/capture was run.
